component.name: PenguLOD
component.summary: Native Skyrim landscape, object, tree and grass LOD generator

description.p: Generate Skyrim SE, AE and VR LOD from a Data folder or a Fluorine or Mod Organizer profile. Includes a desktop interface and CLI, offline grass caching, texture generation, terrain and water, tree geometry budgets and diagnostics.
Game and mod assets are required separately. Generated results must be validated in the game before use in a regular playthrough.
